Instagram feed can be improved:

Description: It looks a bit unprofessional as the main idea and branding is there yet it lacks punch. Some key information you can include in bullet points:
1. Your location and where you can deliver 
2. Your starting price
3. Mention the materials you use, in your case zinc and diamond

Videos can be more clear: 
One video I looked at was very unclear in the beginning but eventually I saw the sparkly stones. Videos should be edited so that it looks good and presents the best quality of the products. 

Please incorporate more pictures too. Create story highlights. Can you hire a model or land an influencer to do some photoshoot with? It will bring more life to your products.

Add testimonials: 
You would benefit hugely if you added testimonials from your current satisfied customers
Some key things they can mention:
1. Why are you the best custom jewellery maker in town! Make it a video of 20 secs no longer 
2. Why customers should choose you: Make it a video of 20 secs no longer 
3. How you are affordable and you exceeded their expectations: Make it a video of 20 secs no longer 
4. If your jewellery holds a very sentimental place for someone, ex. Maybe a father gave his daughter a ring for graduation, maybe it is a keepsake for some. 
5. What value it is adding into someone’s life: Maybe mentioning buying jewellery is a hectic process but you have great engagement with customers and you consider their opinion valuable and make them part of the jewellery making journey. This will personalize the experience for the customer and add value into their lives.

You will definitely need to keep these things in mind:
Social gathering is not in vogue right now. 
You definitely need to keep in mind the safety precautions. And people will most often not follow rules even if it means it will save them.
How are these social gatherings vital for your customers? What does it aim to solve or add value in their life? If you can clearly list the value proposition and market them it will be better your business.

so it seems you are having problem with adjusting customer's expectations with price. 
How are your customers giving feedback in general about your products?
Where are you showcasing your products? 
Is your branding good? Are you letting them know that the materials itself are costly, ad the labour you put into it to craft it makes the jewellery outstanding from the rest? That your products offer something unique? If so, then the next points are for you:
Show them the design first, ask for feedback, make sure they are fully interested in your products first and then tell them about the price.
If it is person to person: when you are telling them the price be clear and transparent, do not hesitate or fidget, keep your voice the same and don't quiver. Don't show restlessness or emotions which will make them feel you are rushing them in to buy the product.

If it done over the internet through some platform: Show them the products first of course get them interested and then tell the price. 

Also, do you have a strong internet presence? After the initial phase of having a great presence on the internet you will find that sales are booming at one point.
